dct_description_sm: A Zoning By-law controls the use of land in your community, such as: how land may be used, where buildings and other structures can be located, the types of buildings that are permitted and how they may be used and the lot sizes and dimensions, parking requirements, building heights and setbacks from the street.  This map depicts the zoning bylaw for the City of Burlington and has links to the documents describing the zoning bylaw.
